hooksMenu.name: Registered hooks
hooksMenu.label: Review hooks
hooksMenu.hint: List every Foundry hook currently used by a clock trigger, so free-text hooks can be audited and removed.

timeSource.name: Time source
timeSource.hint: Where elapsed campaign time comes from. Auto uses Through the Ages when it is active and falls back to Foundry world time otherwise.

sceneTriggerMode.name: Scene triggers fire when
sceneTriggerMode.hint: Whether a scene trigger counts the GM activating a scene for everyone, or the GM merely viewing a scene.

restDebounceSeconds.name: Rest debounce (seconds)
restDebounceSeconds.hint: Systems that report a rest per character are folded into one rest if the reports arrive within this window.

catchUpOnConnect.name: Catch up on connect
catchUpOnConnect.hint: When the first GM connects, evaluate any campaign time that passed since the last processed moment and post one summary.

chatCards.name: Chat cards
chatCards.hint: Post a chat card when a clock changes. GM-only clocks are whispered to GMs.

showBoardToPlayers.name: Show board button to players
showBoardToPlayers.hint: Adds the Clocks button to the Journal sidebar for players. They only ever see clocks they are allowed to see.

playerBoardDensity.name: Board density
playerBoardDensity.hint: How compact the clock board is on this client.

debugLogging.name: Debug logging
debugLogging.hint: Write verbose diagnostics to the console on this client.

allowProposals.name: Allow player proposals
allowProposals.hint: Players may propose a +1 on a project they own and notes on their own corruption clocks. Every proposal waits for a GM to approve it on the board. Note text is kept in the GM-only store; only the pending state is shared.

KindHint.progress: A Blades-style pie that fills forward and stops when full.
KindHint.countdown: A pie that drains, or a deadline on a calendar date.
KindHint.threat: A progress clock with an escalation ladder. Crossing a threshold posts a card.
KindHint.faction: A progress clock tagged to a faction; link it to a rival to race.
KindHint.corruption: A per-character clock bound to a PF2e character, NPC or familiar; its owners see it read-only. Thresholds may link a condition or effect for the GM to apply by hand.
KindHint.alarm: Fires at a campaign moment or after elapsed time. A single segment drawn as a badge; repeat to re-arm.
KindHint.project: Long-term work measured in rests or campaign days.
KindHint.weather: A repeating clock whose segments are named states; one label per segment.

Trigger.dateInvalid: ⚠ not a valid date in the current calendar
Trigger.restAdventureDay: {adv} at rest or on Through the Ages' next adventure day

Board.title: Adventure Clocks
Board.toggleCompleted: Show or hide completed manual clocks
Board.executorHint: Triggers are evaluated by one GM client only: the primary GM (lowest user id among connected GMs).
Board.empty: No clocks yet. Create one, or drop a character onto the board to start a corruption clock.
Board.emptyFiltered: No clocks match the current filters.
Board.dropHint: Drop a character, NPC or familiar onto the board to create a corruption clock for it.
Board.ttaRecommended: Install Through the Ages for calendar deadlines, alarms on dates and date-stamped logs.
Board.importHint: Paste an export, or choose a file. Imported clocks get new ids unless you keep them; linked triggers inside the import are remapped.
Board.importKeepIds: Keep original ids where they do not collide
Board.actorMissing: Actor no longer available. Delete this clock or bind another actor.
Board.racingHint: Two faction clocks linked both ways: when one completes, the other resets.

Editor.title: Clock
Editor.fixErrors: Please fix the following before saving:
Editor.name: Name
Editor.actorHint: Drop an actor here (or on the board) to bind this clock to it.
Editor.triggersHint: Leave empty for a manual clock. Every trigger moves the clock by the given amount, completes it, or resets it.
Editor.scenesHint: Leave empty for any scene. Ctrl-click (Cmd-click on a Mac) to pick several.
Editor.timeWorldHint: Without a campaign calendar, elapsed time is measured from Foundry world time.
Editor.hookHint: Hooks are never evaluated as code. Free-text hooks are listed under Module Settings → Registered hooks.
Editor.noCalendarHint: Calendar-date triggers need Through the Ages (or another calendar time source). Elapsed-time triggers still work from world time.
Editor.restHint: Fires once per Rest for the Night (all resting party members count as one rest) and on “Declare rest”.
Editor.effectHint: Drop a PF2e condition or effect onto a threshold to link it. The link is shown on the card for the GM to drag onto the actor; nothing is applied automatically.
Editor.ownerHint: Shown on the card. With player proposals enabled, the owner may propose +1 on this clock.
Editor.restAdventureDay: Also count “Next adventure day” in Through the Ages
Editor.restAdventureDayHint: The party waking up counts as a rest for this clock, even without Rest for the Night. Needs Through the Ages 2.2 or later.

Hooks.title: Registered hooks
Hooks.hint: Every Foundry hook named by a hook trigger is listened to lazily. Remove one to delete that trigger from every clock.
Hooks.empty: No hook triggers are in use.
Hooks.remove: Remove this hook from every clock

Break.label: Break
Break.title: Break timer
Break.hint: Counts down in real time for everyone at the table, whatever the campaign clock does.
Break.hintRunning: A break is already running; starting a new one replaces it.
Break.over: The break is over — back to the table!
Break.invalid: Enter a number of minutes between {min} and {max}.

Notify.gmOnly: Only a GM can change clocks.
Notify.notPrimary: Another GM client is the primary executor; ask them to evaluate, or wait for them to disconnect.
Notify.invalid: The clock has {n} problem(s). See the editor.
Notify.corruptionExists: {name} already has a corruption clock; opening it.
Notify.restDeclared: Declared a rest for {n} player character(s).
Notify.rewind: Campaign time moved backwards ({from} → {to}). Clocks were not un-ticked; adjust manually if needed.
Notify.rewindWorldTime: World time moved backwards. Clocks were not un-ticked; adjust manually if needed.
Notify.actorTypeRefused: “{name}” is a {type} actor; corruption clocks can only be bound to characters, NPCs and familiars.
Notify.deadlinesInvalid: The calendar's structure changed: {n} clock(s) have a deadline that no longer exists and will not fire until edited: {names}
Notify.newerSchema: {n} clock(s) were saved by a newer version of Sargas Time Bomb. Update the module before editing them, or they will be downgraded on save.

Error.filledRange: Filled must be between 0 and the number of segments.
Error.actorRequired: Actor-owner visibility needs a bound actor.
Error.thresholdRange: A threshold is outside the segment range.
Error.thresholdOrder: Thresholds must be in ascending order.
Error.triggerAdvance: Trigger effect must be a non-zero whole number up to {max}, or complete/reset.
Error.triggerEvery: An elapsed-time trigger needs a period.
Error.triggerDateMissing: A calendar-date trigger needs a date.
Error.triggerDateInvalid: A calendar-date trigger has a date that does not exist in the current calendar.
Error.triggerHook: Hook names may only contain letters, digits, dots, colons, underscores and dashes.
Error.triggerLinkedTarget: A linked trigger needs a target clock.
Error.triggerLinkedWhen: A linked trigger needs a condition.
Error.linkedSelf: A clock cannot link to itself.
Error.linkedDepth: Linked chains may be at most {max} clocks deep.
Error.importNewer: The file uses export format {format}; this version supports {supported}.
Error.importNewerSchema: The file uses schema {schemaVersion}; this version supports {supported}.
Error.importTooMany: Importing would exceed the limit of {max} clocks.
Error.alarmSegments: An alarm has exactly one segment.
Error.repeatAtFull: A repeating clock cannot rest at its complete value; it wraps to the start.
Error.segmentLabelsCount: Segment labels must be empty or exactly one per segment ({segments}).
Error.thresholdEffect: A threshold's effect link is not a valid UUID.
Error.triggerHookSelf: A hook trigger cannot listen to this module's own hooks.
Error.factionGroup: A faction clock needs a group (the faction name).
Error.actorType: The bound actor is a {type}; only characters, NPCs and familiars can carry a clock.
Error.triggerHookDenied: Hook {hook} is emitted by this module's own writes and cannot be a trigger.

Proposal.noteLabel: Note for the GM (added to the clock's log if approved)

Error.notProject: Only project clocks take proposed progress.
Error.notOwner: You do not own this clock.
Error.delta: A proposal moves a clock by one segment.
Error.notCorruption: Only corruption clocks take proposed notes.
Error.notActorBound: This clock is not bound to an actor.
Error.notActorOwner: You do not own this clock's actor.
Error.disabled: The GM has not enabled proposals.
Error.inactive: The proposing user is not connected.
Error.tooMany: You have too many pending proposals.
Error.duplicate: You already have a pending proposal on this clock.
Error.noGM: No GM is connected to receive the proposal.
Error.timeout: The GM did not answer in time.
Error.relayUnavailable: Your proposal could not be sent (user flags are not writable).
Error.noChange: The clock could not move (it may already be complete).
